details: FARUKH REVISION PRO is once again accessible from MORE SUSHI: dedicated visible stock-audit quick action on home, a full-width Revision category in More, and a real link in the authenticated studio navigation. The separate revision.html module provides store selection, stock counts, differences and history; return link to MORE SUSHI added. Existing five mobile navigation tabs and TTK, PDF, projects, clouds and data paths retained. Revision's separate Android APK not modified. Frontpad requires manual entry; no API connection. One Pearl Rose mobile stylesheet edited in place; no additional theme.
